enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping, air conditioner on low, phone on silent on the nightstand
enriched_activities.desc: Lie face-up on the bed with the blanket pulled to the chest. Turn onto the left side. Pull the blanket over the shoulder. Turn onto the right side. Adjust the pillow under the head. Stretch both legs once. Pull the blanket back up. Keep the air conditioner running on low. Leave the phone face-down and on silent on the nightstand. Remain asleep. Turn onto the back briefly. Turn onto the left side again. Keep the eyes closed and breathing steady. Sleep continuously until 06:00.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, using the toilet, washing face and brushing teeth, taking morning medication with tap water, running the water heater for a quick shower
enriched_activities.desc: Open eyes at 06:00. Sit up on the edge of the bed. Stand up. Walk from Bedroom 1 to the Bathroom. Turn on the bathroom light. Sit on the toilet and urinate. Stand up and flush the toilet. Turn on the cold tap. Wet both hands. Pick up the soap and rub it between the palms. Wash the face with both hands. Rinse the face. Turn off the tap. Pick up the towel and wipe the face dry. Hang the towel back on the hook. Pick up the toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste onto the bristles. Brush the teeth for about two minutes. Rinse the mouth with tap water from a cup. Spit into the sink. Rinse the toothbrush. Put the toothbrush back in the holder. Open the medicine cabinet. Take out the morning medication bottle. Twist off the cap. Tip one tablet into the palm. Put the tablet in the mouth. Fill the cup with tap water. Swallow the tablet with water. Close the bottle and put it back on the shelf. Close the medicine cabinet. Turn the water heater dial on. Wait for the water to warm. Step into the shower. Wet the body. Apply soap. Rinse the body. Turn off the tap. Step out of the shower. Pick up the towel and dry the body.

enriched_activities.activity: Drying off, dressing in work clothes for the on-site clinic and school shift, checking the day's appointment list on the phone
enriched_activities.desc: Finish drying the hair with the towel. Hang the towel on the bedroom hook. Open the wardrobe door. Take out the work top and trousers. Put on the work top. Put on the trousers. Pull on socks. Put on shoes. Close the wardrobe door. Pick up the phone from the nightstand. Unlock the screen with the thumb. Open the appointment app. Scroll through the day's appointment list. Read the first three entries. Lock the phone. Put the phone in the trouser pocket.

enriched_activities.activity: Making breakfast with the kettle and toaster, feeding the dog, eating quickly while reading reminder texts on the phone
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the Kitchen. Turn on the kitchen light. Fill the kettle with water from the tap. Place the kettle on its base and press the switch. Open the cupboard and take out two slices of bread. Put the bread into the toaster and press the lever down. Open the dog food container. Scoop one cup of dry dog food into the dog bowl. Refill the dog water bowl from the tap. Place both bowls on the floor. Wait for the kettle to boil. Press the toaster lever up when it pops. Put the toast on a plate. Pour hot water into a mug and add a tea bag. Sit at the kitchen counter. Eat the toast. Drink the tea. Pick up the phone and open the messages app. Read three reminder texts from relatives. Reply with one short text. Take the plate and mug to the sink. Rinse both. Turn off the kitchen light. Walk to the front door.

enriched_activities.activity: Walking the dog around the block on the usual quiet route, keeping to well-lit streets
enriched_activities.desc: Clip the leash onto the dog collar. Open the front door. Step outside with the dog. Close the front door. Walk down the front path to the pavement. Turn left. Walk the usual block route. Keep to the well-lit side of the street. Stop at the kerb and look both ways. Cross the road. Continue walking past the corner shop. Let the dog stop and sniff the grass verge. Pull the leash gently to continue. Turn right at the second corner. Walk the loop back toward the house. Stop at the front gate. Open the gate. Walk up the path. Open the front door. Unclip the leash from the dog collar. Hang the leash on the hook by the door. Step back out and close the door.

enriched_activities.activity: School-run drop-off duties at the primary school, then walking to the bus stop
enriched_activities.desc: Walk with Member 3 along the pavement toward the primary school. Carry the school bag for the first stretch. Hand the bag back at the school gate. Stop at the gate and say to Member 3: 'Have a good day, text me at lunch.' Wait at the gate until Member 3 walks into the schoolyard. Turn around. Walk to the main road. Press the pedestrian crossing button. Wait for the green signal. Cross the road. Walk two more blocks to the bus stop. Stop at the bus stop sign. Take the phone out. Open the transit app and check the next bus arrival time. Put the phone back in the pocket.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting by public transit to the community clinic, reading messages and planning the morning appointments
enriched_activities.desc: Board the bus at the front door. Tap the transit card on the reader. Walk down the aisle. Sit in an empty seat by the window. Place the bag on the lap. Take out the phone. Open the messages app. Read a text from Member 2. Reply with a short text. Open the appointment list app. Scroll through the morning appointment names. Note the first appointment time. Open the notes app and type three planning items for the morning. Look up at the stop announcements. Pull the stop request cord. Stand up. Walk to the rear door. Step off the bus. Tap the card on the exit reader. Walk two blocks to the clinic entrance.

enriched_activities.activity: Working the on-site clinic shift: community healthcare appointments, intake paperwork, checking in on regular patients and their medication refills
enriched_activities.desc: Push open the clinic door. Walk to the staff room. Hang the coat on the hook. Put the bag in the locker. Turn on the clinic computer. Log in with the staff password. Open the appointment scheduling screen. Print the morning appointment list. Pick up the printed list from the printer. Walk to the reception desk. Sit down at the desk. Greet the first patient and say: 'Good morning, please take a seat.' Open the intake form on the computer. Type the patient's name, date of birth and address. Ask the patient the medication questions. Type the answers into the form. Print the intake form. Hand the form and a pen to the patient. Take back the signed form. File it in the patient folder. Stand up and walk to the examination room. Take the blood pressure cuff from the shelf. Wrap the cuff around the patient's arm. Press the start button on the monitor. Read the numbers. Write them on the chart. Repeat the same steps for the next four patients. Open the medication refill cabinet. Count the remaining boxes of each regular medication. Write the refill order list. Walk to the fax machine. Send the refill order to the pharmacy. Return to the reception desk. Answer the ringing desk phone and say: 'Community clinic, how can I help?' Write down the caller's request. Sit down and update the patient records on the computer. Stand up and stretch the arms once. Walk to the staff room and refill the water bottle from the tap.

enriched_activities.activity: Lunch break near the clinic, eating a packed lunch and sending one-on-one text check-ins to relatives
enriched_activities.desc: Walk out of the clinic with the lunch bag. Walk to the bench outside the clinic entrance. Sit down on the bench. Open the lunch bag. Take out the lunch box. Open the lid. Take out the fork. Eat the packed lunch. Drink water from the bottle. Close the lunch box. Take out the phone. Open the messages app. Open the chat with a relative. Type a short check-in text and send it. Open a second chat. Type another short text and send it. Read the two replies. Type one more reply. Put the phone in the pocket. Stand up. Throw the napkin into the bin. Walk back to the clinic door.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing clinic duties, then crossing to the primary school for the education aide afternoon block with small reading groups
enriched_activities.desc: Walk back into the clinic. Sit at the reception desk. Open the afternoon appointment screen. Call the next patient name. Complete the check-in paperwork. Type the notes into the patient record. Print the summary sheet. Hand the sheet to the patient. Repeat the check-in steps for the next two patients. Stand up. Walk to the medication cabinet. Restock the printed refill slips. Close the cabinet. Turn off the clinic computer. Pick up the bag from the locker. Put on the coat. Walk out of the clinic. Cross the road at the crossing. Walk to the primary school gate. Sign in at the school office. Walk to the classroom. Take the reading group folder from the shelf. Sit at the small group table with four children. Hand out the reading books. Point at the first line and say: 'Start here, read slowly.' Listen and correct pronunciation. Turn the page. Repeat with the second child. Collect the books at the end. Write a short note in the reading log. Walk back to the school office. Sign out.

enriched_activities.activity: Finishing education aide duties, then a short community visit and pharmacy errand before heading home
enriched_activities.desc: Walk out of the primary school. Walk three blocks to the community centre. Knock on the door. Enter and greet the neighbour. Sit down at the table. Take the notebook out of the bag. Write three notes about the neighbour's medication schedule. Stand up. Say: 'I will check back on Thursday.' Walk out. Walk to the pharmacy. Push open the pharmacy door. Walk to the counter. Hand the prescription slip to the pharmacist. Wait at the counter. Pay with the card on the reader. Put the medication box into the bag. Say thank you to the pharmacist. Walk out of the pharmacy. Walk to the bus stop.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting home by public transit, replying to text messages and confirming tomorrow's schedule
enriched_activities.desc: Board the bus. Tap the transit card. Walk to a seat. Sit down. Take the phone out. Open the messages app. Read a text from Member 2 about dinner. Reply with a short text. Open the calendar app. Check tomorrow's appointment list. Type two reminder notes. Open the chat with a relative and reply to one message. Look up at the route display. Pull the stop request cord. Stand up. Walk to the door. Step off the bus. Tap the card on the exit reader. Walk the four blocks home. Open the front gate.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking dinner with Member 2, using the induction cooker and rice cooker, preparing a meal compatible with everyone's dietary needs
enriched_activities.desc: Open the front door. Take off the shoes. Hang up the coat. Walk into the Kitchen. Turn on the kitchen light. Wash both hands at the sink. Open the refrigerator door. Take out the vegetables and the protein pack. Close the refrigerator door. Place the items on the counter. Rinse the vegetables under the tap. Pick up the knife and cut the vegetables on the cutting board. Turn on the induction cooker. Pour oil into the pan. Add the vegetables to the pan. Stir with the spatula. Rinse the rice in the inner pot. Fill the rice cooker pot with water. Place the pot into the rice cooker. Close the lid and press the cook button. Turn on the range hood. Say to Member 2: 'I will take the low-salt portion out first.' Add the protein to the pan. Stir and cover with the lid. Turn off the induction cooker when done. Take the plates from the cupboard.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating dinner with Member 2 and Member 3 at the table, air conditioner on, phone face-down for a calm meal
enriched_activities.desc: Carry the dishes from the Kitchen to the Dining Room. Place the dishes on the table. Turn on the dining room light. Turn on the air conditioner. Pull out a chair. Sit down at the table. Wait for Member 2 and Member 3 to sit. Pick up the serving spoon. Serve rice onto three plates. Pick up the chopsticks. Eat the meal. Drink water from the glass. Pick up the serving spoon again and take a second portion of vegetables. Say to Member 3: 'How was school today?' Listen to the answer. Put the chopsticks down. Take the phone out of the pocket and place it face-down on the table. Finish the meal. Stand up. Pick up the empty plates.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing dishes with Member 3, wiping the counters, packing tomorrow's lunch, and taking the evening medication dose
enriched_activities.desc: Carry the plates to the Kitchen sink. Turn on the tap. Pick up the sponge. Squeeze dish soap onto the sponge. Wash the plates and bowls. Rinse each item under the tap. Hand the items to Member 3 to dry. Place the dry dishes in the cupboard. Turn off the tap. Pick up the cloth. Wipe the counter surfaces. Wipe the induction cooker top. Open the refrigerator door. Take out the lunch container. Place rice and vegetables into the lunch box. Close the lid. Put the lunch box into the refrigerator. Close the refrigerator door. Open the medicine cabinet. Take out the evening medication bottle. Twist off the cap. Tip one tablet into the palm. Fill a glass with tap water. Swallow the tablet. Close the bottle and put it back. Close the cabinet. Pick up the leash from the hook.

enriched_activities.activity: Evening dog walk along the familiar neighbourhood loop, staying on well-lit paths
enriched_activities.desc: Clip the leash onto the dog collar. Open the front door. Step outside with the dog and Member 2. Close the front door. Walk down the front path. Turn right onto the pavement. Walk the familiar loop side by side with Member 2. Keep to the well-lit side of the street. Stop at the kerb and look both ways. Cross the road. Continue past the corner shop. Let the dog stop at the grass verge. Pull the leash gently. Say to Member 2: 'Tomorrow I finish at four.' Turn at the second corner. Walk back along the loop. Stop at the front gate. Open the gate. Walk up the path. Open the front door. Unclip the leash. Hang the leash on the hook. Close the front door.

enriched_activities.activity: Sitting on the sofa sending one-on-one text check-ins to relatives and neighbours, logging volunteer notes in a notebook (joined by Member 3 until 20:15)
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the Living Room. Turn on the living room light. Turn on the air conditioner. Sit down on the sofa. Take the phone out of the pocket. Open the messages app. Open the chat with a relative and type a check-in text. Send the message. Read the reply. Open the chat with a neighbour. Type a second check-in text. Send it. Put the phone on the sofa arm. Pick up the notebook from the side table. Pick up the pen. Write three volunteer visit notes on the page. Put the pen down. Show the notebook page to Member 3 and say: 'This is the Thursday visit.' Put the notebook back on the side table. Pick up the phone again. Open one more chat and send a short text. Say goodnight to Member 3 when Member 3 leaves the room at 20:15. Stand up from the sofa.

enriched_activities.activity: Showering with the water heater, running the dehumidifier and fan, winding down from the day
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the Bathroom. Turn on the bathroom light. Turn on the water heater. Turn on the exhaust fan. Turn on the dehumidifier. Take off the clothes and place them in the laundry basket. Step into the shower. Wet the body under the water. Pick up the soap and lather the body. Rinse the body. Pick up the shampoo bottle. Squeeze shampoo into the palm. Wash the hair. Rinse the hair. Turn off the tap. Step out of the shower. Pick up the towel and dry the body and hair. Hang the towel on the hook. Put on the sleepwear. Turn off the water heater. Turn off the dehumidifier. Turn off the exhaust fan. Turn off the bathroom light. Walk out of the Bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching TV in bed at low volume, updating the paper planner with appointments, cost-checking the cash budget for the week
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 1. Turn on the bedroom light. Turn on the TV. Press the volume button to lower the sound. Sit on the bed. Pull back the blanket. Lie back against the pillow. Watch the TV screen. Pick up the paper planner from the nightstand. Pick up the pen. Write tomorrow's clinic and school appointments on the page. Write the pharmacy pickup time. Put the pen down. Open the cash budget envelope from the nightstand drawer. Count the notes on the bed. Write the remaining amount in the planner. Put the notes back into the envelope. Put the envelope back in the drawer. Close the drawer. Pick up the TV remote. Press the power button to turn off the TV. Put the remote down on the nightstand.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading a devotional passage, quiet prayer, dimming the desk lamp and setting the phone alarm
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up the devotional book from the nightstand. Open to the marked page. Read the passage silently, moving the finger along the lines. Close the book. Place the book back on the nightstand. Fold both hands on the lap. Bow the head. Sit still in prayer for several minutes. Lift the head. Reach to the desk lamp switch. Turn the lamp down to the lowest setting. Pick up the phone from the nightstand. Open the clock app. Set the alarm for 06:00. Confirm the alarm screen. Lock the phone. Place the phone face-down on the nightstand. Pull the blanket up to the chest.

enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping, air conditioner on low, light off
enriched_activities.desc: Turn off the desk lamp. Keep the air conditioner running on low. Lie down flat on the bed. Pull the blanket over the shoulder. Turn onto the left side. Adjust the pillow under the head. Close the eyes. Breathe steadily. Turn onto the right side. Shift the legs once. Keep still. Remain asleep. Turn onto the back briefly. Pull the blanket back up. Continue sleeping until the end of the night.
